title: IndRegBias: A Dataset for Studying Indian Regional Biases in English and Code-Mixed Social Media Comments

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs) and Indic Language Models (ILMs) on a newly curated dataset (IndRegBias) of 25,000 English and code-mixed social media comments. The models are evaluated using zero-shot, few-shot, and fine-tuning setups for binary classification (detecting the presence of regional bias) and multi-class classification (predicting the severity of the bias as mild, moderate, or severe).
